Create one or multiple transactions on behalf of a user. Transactions with source_message_id are idempotent: an already stored message, or a legacy automated transaction with the same account, amount, expense and date ±2 min, is returned in "skipped" instead of being inserted.

post.description: Kept for compatibility: accounts no longer need confirmation. Always returns 200.
Logs in with email and password. If the account has no password yet (migrated users) it returns 403 "user needs to reset the password": use /users/set-initial-password.
post.summary: Login and get an access token

403.description: The user must create a password

put.description: Changes the password using the current one. Every other session is closed; new tokens are returned for the current one.

401.description: Wrong current password or invalid new password

post.description: Rotates the refresh token and returns new tokens. Reusing an old refresh token revokes every session of the user.

401.description: Invalid, expired or reused refresh token

post.description: Kept for compatibility: no emails are sent. Always returns 200.
Only works when the account has no password (migrated or reset by the admin) and, if INITIAL_PASSWORD_UNTIL is set, before that date. Returns tokens.
